summary_zh: PhotoCraft 是一款用纯 Rust 从零编写的开源照片编辑器，提供图层、蒙版、调整图层、图层样式、文字、矢量、画笔和真实 PSD 文件读写等功能，是一款原生应用，可离线使用。
audience_zh: 适合需要图层式图像编辑、Photoshop 式操作习惯、PSD 兼容和离线原生编辑的用户，也适合希望通过 CLI、JSON 控制通道或 MCP 服务器用脚本或 AI 代理驱动编辑流程的人。

evidence.quote: PhotoCraft: An open-source photo editor written from scratch in pure Rust
Layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes and real PSD files,
in a native app written entirely in Rust. Open source, offline, and yours.
Every action is a command, so you can drive the same engine from the UI, the CLI, a JSON control channel or an MCP server.
